title: Oldest known drawing
place: Blombos Cave, Western Cape, South Africa
summary: Nine red lines drawn with an ochre crayon on a small rock fragment. Engraved ochre pieces from the same cave are 70,000-100,000 years old.
why: Deliberate abstract marks: among the earliest known visual symbols.

notes.problem: 'The start of visual symbols' contradicts the record's own summary: engraved ochre from the same cave is older (70,000-100,000 years).
